text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown Prince Hassan to discuss on Wednesday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ways of removing obstacles to peace.
- Elections to be held on November 4, 1997 and nominations for candidates standing for elections begin on October 10.
- Moslem Brotherhood blame the government for closing the door for dialogue over the parliamentary elections.

- Interior Minister Nazir Rasheed says Jordan will not accept presence of international observers at the coming elections; says the next few days will witness heavy turnout by voters to register on the electoral lists.
- Crown Prince Hassan discusses with Israeli officials lifting the siege on Palestinian self-rule areas and a resumption of Israeli-Palestinian peace negotiations.
- Palestinian leader Arafat meets Hamas leader Abu Marzook in Amman.
- Foreign Minister Fayez al-Tarawnah says closure of bridge between the West Bank and Jordan is a violation of the Jordan-Israel peace treaty.
